headline: Nifty slips as *volatility rises* and sector gains diverge
subline: Mixed sector performances and rising volatility marked the session.
hero_text: A mixed session with the FMCG and IT sectors showing resilience amid a lack of clear catalysts.

why.title: No Clear Catalyst
why.desc: Market dropped with no clear cause.

bonus_text: Market breadth positive with 1.33 advancing stocks for every decliner.
movers_note_gainers: NESTLEIND and TATACONSUM led the gains today.
movers_note_losers: SHRIRAMFIN and HDFCLIFE were among the top losers.
watch_text: Watch for tomorrow's GDP data from the UK and major US indicators.
lessons: No clear catalysts for the market's dip today.
FMCG and IT sectors showed notable resilience.
Contrasting FII selling and DII buying marked institutional flows.
alert_text: Focus on UK GDP and key US economic indicators tomorrow.
cta_sub: Full wrap every evening. Next bell is Thursday.
next_text: Thursday, 15 October 2026. Watch the GDP data and US economic releases.

Nifty slipped 0.44% to close at 22,622.70 amid rising volatility.
FMCG and IT sectors showed strength while India VIX rose 3.58%.
